{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Drop duplicates on patient_id, keeping the one with highest sample_seq
df = df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Verify the new shape
print("New dataframe shape:", df.shape)

# Check for remaining duplicates
print("Remaining duplicates on patient_id:", df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum())

# Verify the arm and severity distributions after deduplication
print("\nNew arm distribution:")
print(df['arm'].value_counts())

print("\nNew severity distribution:")
print(df['severity'].value_counts())

# Cross-tabulate arm vs severity after deduplication
print("\nCross-tabulation of arm vs severity after deduplication:")
print(pd.crosstab(df['arm'], df['severity']))"}
